title: Image generation request
description:
Canonical request object produced by the image-gen interactive picker and consumed by the image-gen executor.

Contract:
  - model_id MUST be a stable id defined in config.yaml (same directory), format <machine>:<backend>:<slug>.
  - The executor MUST re-validate every setting against that model's settings map in config.yaml
    (defaults, min/max, multiple_of, choices) — this schema enforces only the generic envelope;
    per-model bounds live in config.yaml because they differ per backend and per installed model.
  - seed: null means 'random' (executor picks and records the actual seed used in the history log).
  - Backend-unsupported keys must be omitted, not sent as null (e.g. cfg_scale/sampler/scheduler
    are ComfyUI-only; Unsloth ignores them). The picker derives the allowed keys from config.yaml.
  - ComfyUI Qwen-Image-2.1-int8: width MUST equal height (single resolution param).
  - Unsloth models: width/height must be multiples of 32 and area width*height <= 4300800.

See example-request.json for a complete instance.

schema_version.description: Bump when breaking the request shape; executor rejects mismatches.

model_id.description: Stable model id from config.yaml, e.g. 'macbook:unsloth:qwen-image-2.1-uncensored'.

prompt.description: Positive prompt, verbatim to the engine.

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt. ComfyUI models carry a baked negative ('blurry, low quality'); null uses the model default. Unsloth will use null as empty.

settings.description: Generation knobs. Keys are backend-model dependent — the set defined for the selected model in config.yaml. Generic bounds below are the outer envelope; config.yaml holds the per-model truth the executor enforces.

width.description: Output width, px. Per-model multiple_of in config.yaml (8 for ComfyUI; 32 for Unsloth).

height.description: Output height, px. Per-model multiple_of in config.yaml.

steps.description: Sampling steps. Per-model range in config.yaml (e.g. Z-Image-Turbo 4-8; Qwen-Image-2.1 20-50).

cfg_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance. ComfyUI models here are pinned to 1.0; omit for Unsloth (server-side fixed).

seed.description: null = random. Executor records the resolved seed in the history log.

sampler.description: ComfyUI-only; choices come from config.yaml (verified: res_multistep for Z-Image, euler for Qwen-2.1). null = model default.

scheduler.description: ComfyUI-only; verified values: 'simple'. null = model default.

n.description: Number of images. Unsloth supports n; ComfyUI graphs here generate one.

init_image.description: Local path or data: URL for Unsloth reference/edit workflows. Executor converts to data:image data URI for the API. ComfyUI img2img is out of scope for the verified graphs.

strength.description: Unsloth-only, edit/reference strength; null = default when init_image given.

output.description: Output destination. Both optional; executor falls back to config.yaml defaults.

dir.description: Output directory (absolute or ~-prefixed). Created if missing.

filename_template.description: Optional template; '{ts}' -> epoch timestamp, '{model}' -> model slug, '{n}' -> batch index, '{seed}' -> resolved seed. Default: '{ts}_{model}_{n}.png'.

examples.prompt: a glossy red cube floating above a mirror plane, studio lighting, product shot
green tractor in a field of autumn pumpkins, golden hour
